_metadata.decision_rule: Green-light if >=3 of 5 queries score >=3 unique-value (per docs/plans/2026-06-08-A-instagram-feasibility-test.md § 1).
_metadata.scores_note: Ahmed gave ranges for two queries (Birkenstock 2-3, Garden of Life 1-2); FLOOR values recorded so the gate decision is robust to rounding. Dyson given as 'maybe a 3' — recorded 3.
_metadata.verdict_detail: 3 of 5 queries >=3 even at floor scores (Tom Ford 3, Fenty 3, Dyson 3). Zero 4s/5s — social adds enrichment (wear-feel, who-its-for, GCC influencer UGC reviews), NOT prices or availability. Strongest in beauty/fragrance, weakest in supplements — matches the approved Apify category scoping (fragrances/makeup/skincare/fashion; supplements excluded). Apify integration CONFIRMED for Bundle B S3 Lane S3 at <=$0.005/comparison, category-scoped, with kill-switch review at S3 exit eval (if social signals do not move usefulness=true, flags off).
